features: Compatibility: Designed exclusively for 10.2" all-new Kindle Scribe 2024. Will NOT fit any other kindle tablet
Auto Wake/ Sleep: Automatically wakes or puts your Kindle scibe to sleep when opening and closing the case.

[Easy-Access Pencil Holder] Specifically designed with a pen holder to protect and store your kindle scribe pen. Simply push the pen out via the slot in the back. Keep the pen always ready for you. (Case only, kindle scribe pen is NOT included!)
Multi Viewing Angle: This case allows your Kindle Scribe to different multi viewing angle securely.
Simple but Elegant Style: Premium synthetic leather with sturdy construction brings you a more protective and eye-catching case.
Accurate openings will not affect any key operations and basic functions, such as synchronous, charging, headphones etc.
